dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Grand Rapids area (NTS 84A/SE) (GIS data, line features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the line features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 566, Surficial Geology of the Grand Rapids Area (NTS 84A/SE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Grand Rapids Area (NTS 84A/SE) (GIS data, line features)
